invariants: Exactly one Dog is ever constructed, inside HouseFactory::new().
dog() never constructs a Dog; it clones the Arc handle.
new_cat() constructs a new Cat on every call.
responsibilities: hold the one house dog, created once in HouseFactory::new() with the name "Buddy"
hand out a handle to that same dog on every dog() call
build a brand-new Cat on every new_cat() call
summary: The factory builds and holds animals. It alone knows the dog is shared and the cats are fresh.
